In [[mathematics]], the '''Hochschild–Mostow group''', introduced by {{harvs |txt |last=Hochschild |authorlink=Gerhard Hochschild |last2=Mostow |author2-link=George Mostow |year=1957}}, is the universal pro-affine [[algebraic group]] generated by a group.
